name: sagemath-enhanced
description: An enhanced VS Code extension for SageMath, providing advanced features and integrations.

sagemathEnhanced.autoDeleteGeneratedFile.description: Automatically delete the generated .sage.py file after running a SageMath script.

sagemathEnhanced.useWSL.description: Use WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) to run SageMath scripts.

sagemathEnhanced.enableDiagnostics.description: Enable diagnostic messages and error checking

sagemathEnhanced.enableCompletion.description: Enable code completion and IntelliSense features

sagemathEnhanced.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Maximum number of problems shown in the diagnostics

sagemathEnhanced.enableSageDocs.description: Use the installed SageMath runtime to provide accurate documentation and function signatures (via a background sage process). When disabled or unavailable, falls back to the bundled documentation.

sagemathEnhanced.sagePythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the documentation daemon when `sage -python` is not available (e.g. conda/micromamba installs where sage is importable from the env's python). Leave empty to auto-detect (tries the configured interpreter path, then `python`, then `python3`).

sagemathEnhanced.sageDocLaunchMethod.description: How the documentation daemon is launched. "auto" tries methods in order and remembers the one that works. You can pin one of: "auto", "sage -python", "sage --python", "python", "python3", or the value of sagePythonPath (if set). Pinning avoids the auto-detection probe on every restart.

sagemathEnhanced.hoverVerbosity.description: Verbosity of hover documentation. "short" shows only the signature and summary; "full" adds the description, parameter table, and examples.

sagemathEnhanced.hoverShowExamples.description: Show code examples in hover documentation (only applies when verbosity is "full").

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
